title: SSC CGL Static GK
summary: SSC CGL Tier I Static GK past questions from 113 shifts, 2023 to 2025, five a day. Questions SSC asked again and the question types it keeps asking come first, ranked together by how often they were asked, then every other question.
note: Repeats are counted across the 113 Tier I shifts, 2023 to 2025, including questions SSC reprinted word for word. SSC rarely reprints a General Awareness question but asks the same fact again in new words: those are the repeats, and a fact list it keeps drawing on (the state of a folk dance, the instrument of a maestro, the author of a book) is a type. Static GK holds the settled facts moved out of Current Affairs on 2026-11-19 (scripts/ssc-cgl/static-gk/README.md). Groups were found by a chapter-by-chapter reading (scripts/homework/REVIEW_BRIEF_SSC_GK.md) and checked in the main session. Questions marked defective are left out.
